fusions.name: Clamp and Hold
fusions.desc: Your jaws clamp on the target for 30 damage, always a critical hit, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Thrashing Roll
fusions.desc: You roll and thrash, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: The Wait Ends
fusions.desc: After a 2 second cast, increases your damage by 35% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Unbloodied Stillness
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 15 seconds.
